working: Alumni eNews - July 2026 (sent 7/9) was the best recent send: +77.2% traffic lift (14.5 to 25.7 daily sessions) with a 57.3% open rate, roughly double the 25-35% health/nonprofit benchmark.
Big-lift playbook is repeatable: Staff-Client eNews - May 2026 drove +66.5% lift and Alumni Final Reminder - June 2026 drove +65.2%, both pushing direct sessions to ~50/day in the 3 days after send.

List health is excellent overall: 51.62% average open rate across the last 100 campaigns, far above benchmark, and Referring Partners eNews keeps the best click-to-open ratio (4.35% in June, 3.82% in July).

Email attribution is finally registering: the three July sends show 2-4 GA4 Email sessions each in their 3-day windows, versus zero for every send before July - a first sign links are starting to carry tracking.
not_working: UTM leakage is still the core measurement problem: Email is credited only 16 of 31,959 window sessions (0.1%) while sends clearly move Direct - e.g. Alumni Reminder 7/16 logged 4 email vs 35 direct sessions, and Staff-Client May (the +66.5% send) logged 0 email vs 53 direct.

Click rates are below benchmark even when opens are strong: Staff-Client July managed only 0.43% click rate and 0.89% click-to-open despite a 47.9% open rate; account-wide average click rate is 1.94%.
SEO slipped slightly vs the 8/4 run: GSC clicks 17 to 13, impressions 1,658 to 1,525, and impression-weighted position 19.41 to 19.72.
Organic Social remains a weak channel at 5.4% of sessions, and no newsletter has gone out since 7/20 - a 2+ week gap.
do_next: Add utm_source=constantcontact&utm_medium=email to every link in the next sends; the 4-vs-35 email/direct split on 7/16 shows most newsletter traffic is still mis-credited as Direct.

Stop stacking sends: the two-list 7/20 send day went -27.3% while the solo Alumni send on Thu 7/9 went +77.2% - space Staff-Client and Referring Partners at least a few days apart and favor early/mid-month Thursday sends.
Repromote the themes behind the three +65% lifts (Alumni July, Staff-Client May, Alumni Final Reminder June) and get the August cycle out now - no send since 7/20.

summary: Email opens stay exceptional (51.6% avg) and solo alumni sends reliably lift site traffic (+77% on 7/9), but nearly all of that traffic is mis-attributed to Direct for lack of UTM tags, click rates run below benchmark, and GSC clicks slipped 17 to 13 vs the last run.
